title: Welcome to Dwarf Fortress
document: Prepare to guide your stout charges to fortune in a world fraught with many perils. You'll begin by creating your world and watching the region's history unfold. Once this process is complete, you can prepare a group and send them out to seek wealth deep in the mountains. As you dig deeper and more citizens take up residence in your outpost, your doings will attract attention, both wanted and unwanted. Deal with challenges as they arise, and you might one day find that your humble settlement has grown to become a Mountainhome, the center of your civilization.
document_translation: 准备好引导你勇敢的矮人们在危机四伏的世界中走向命运吧。你将生成一个世界并观察其中的历史演变。在该过程完成后，你就可以组建一支队伍并派遣他们进入群山深处以寻求财富。随着挖掘的深入和更多的居民加入你的哨所，你的所作所为将吸引各方注意，无论你意愿如何。应对突如其来的挑战，也许某一天你会发现你那简陋的定居点已然发展为一座山地之家，并成为母文明的中心。

title: Quick start and short tutorial?
title_translation: 来个简短教程并快速入门？
document: Would you like your fortress located in a forested mineral-rich region of this world where you can play through a short tutorial? Non-interactive help will be available whatever you decide.
document_translation: 想要在这个世界中寻找一片森林茂密且矿产丰富的地区来建立你的要塞并进行一个简短教程么？无论作出哪种选择你还是可以在游戏中找到非交互的帮助。

title: On your own!
document: If this is your first time playing, please heed the embark warnings about aquifers, saltwater, and other hazards. Some locations are challenging even for experienced players, and it will be a very short game indeed if you don't know how to deal with them![B]After you embark, help is available by pressing the help button in the top right corner, including all of the tutorials.
document_translation: 这是你首次游玩的话，请注意出发时关于含水层、咸水和其他危险的警告。有些地点甚至对老玩家来讲也充满挑战，如果你不知道如何应对，游戏很可能会很快结束！[B]出发后你可以通过点击右上角的帮助按钮来获取帮助，其中包含了所有的教程。

title: Camera controls
document: Your view is focused on one elevation at a time.  To move the camera around, press [KEY:23] [KEY:25] [KEY:24] [KEY:26] or hold the middle mouse button and drag the view.
document_translation: 你的视野每次只能停留在一个高度上。  要移动摄像机，请通过键盘上的 [KEY:23] [KEY:25] [KEY:24] [KEY:26] 或者按住鼠标中键并拖动视角。

document: To change the camera's elevation, press [KEY:39] and [KEY:40] or [C:2:0:1]roll the mouse wheel[C:7:0:0].  Hold shift to move faster.
document_translation: 要调整当前聚焦的高度，请通过键盘上的 [KEY:39] 和 [KEY:40] 或者 [C:2:0:1]滚动鼠标滚轮[C:7:0:0]。  按住 Shift 键可以调整的更快。

document: When your view is in the air above other tiles, you can see them below, but you can only interact with objects in your current elevation.
document_translation: 你虽然可以通过空气格子看到下层的格子，但你只能和在同一高度的物体进行交互。

document: The view will be dark underground until you begin mining.  You can move the camera to the surface with the surface button (highlighted.)  The [KEY:296] hotkey will recenter on your wagon.
document_translation: 直到你开始挖掘，地下的格子都不会显示。  你可以通过点击地表按钮（已高亮）来快速切换到地表层。  键盘上的 [KEY:296] 按键将聚焦到你的马车。

document: You can zoom in and out of the play area using [KEY:7][KEY:8], [C:2:0:1]Ctrl+mouse wheel[C:7:0:0], or the indicated buttons.
document_translation: 你可以使用键盘上的 [KEY:7][KEY:8] 键、[C:2:0:1]Ctrl + 鼠标滚轮[C:7:0:0] 或标注的按钮来放大和缩小游戏区域的大小。

title: Mining
document: It's time to get to work!  Let's start by digging a stairwell into the ground.  There may be plenty of hillside to dig into, but you'll want to seek wealth below the surface.[B]Mining tasks are designated on the play area.  Begin by clicking the highlighted [C:5:0:1]Mining[C:7:0:0] button.
document_translation: 干活的时间到了！  让我们先挖一条通往地下的楼梯井。  虽然可能会有很多可供挖掘的山坡，但你最好在地表下尝试寻找有用的资源。[B]挖掘任务会在游戏区域中标出。  首先，请点击闪烁的[C:5:0:1]挖掘[C:7:0:0]按钮。

document: There are several ways to mine.  Stairwells (selected) start at one elevation and are completed at the next.  [C:2:0:1]Click[C:7:0:0] the surface, [C:2:0:1]move the camera down one level[C:7:0:0], and [C:2:0:1]click[C:7:0:0] the underground.  Reversing the order also works.
document_translation: 菜单中显示的有几种挖掘方式。  楼梯井（已选中）需要从一个高度开始并在另一个高度结束。  [C:2:0:1]点击[C:7:0:0]地表，然后[C:2:0:1]切换到地下一层[C:7:0:0]，接着[C:2:0:1]点击[C:7:0:0]地下。  当然你也可以从地下开始操作。

document: Now we'll unpause the game and let the miner finish the task.  Press [KEY:294] to unpause or use the highlighted controls at the top of the screen.  You should pause regularly starting out.
document_translation: 现在让我们解除游戏暂停来让矿工完成这个挖掘任务。  按下键盘上的 [KEY:294] 键或屏幕右上角闪烁的按钮来解除暂停。  你刚开始的时候应该经常暂停游戏。

document: Let's make a safe place to work.  Select [C:5:0:1]Regular Mining[C:7:0:0] mode, to the left of [C:5:0:1]Stair Mining[C:7:0:0] mode.[B]Dig a rectangle underground big enough for a large [C:6:0:0]Stockpile[C:7:0:0] and some [C:6:0:0]Workshops[C:7:0:0].  Consider that most [C:6:0:0]Workshops[C:7:0:0] are 3x3 squares.  Mining through the stone layers further down may take longer, but it leaves [C:6:0:1]Boulders[C:7:0:0] which are an essential building material.[B]Later you can consider making a [C:3:0:0]Meeting Area[C:7:0:0] from the [C:5:0:1]Zones[C:7:0:0] menu. Otherwise your citizens will continue to gather by the [C:6:0:0]Wagon[C:7:0:0] outside.
document_translation: 接下来让我们创建一个安全的工作区域。 选择[C:5:0:1]常规挖掘[C:7:0:0]模式，在[C:5:0:1]楼梯挖掘[C:7:0:0]模式的左侧。[B]然后在地下给[C:6:0:0]储物处[C:7:0:0]和[C:6:0:0]工坊[C:7:0:0]挖掘一个足够大的矩形区域。  请注意大多数[C:6:0:0]工坊[C:7:0:0]都是 3x3 格子的大小。  开挖更深的岩层虽然可能会花费更长的世界，但是挖开后会留下作为重要的建筑材料的[C:6:0:1]石材[C:7:0:0]。[B]稍后你可以考虑从[C:5:0:1]区划[C:7:0:0]菜单中圈选一个[C:3:0:0]集会区域[C:7:0:0]。否则你的矮人将继续在外面的[C:6:0:0]马车[C:7:0:0]附近聚集。

title: Stockpiles
document: The supplies on the wagon are in danger of being carried off by wild creatures!  It's time to build a [C:6:0:0]Stockpile[C:7:0:0] underground to unload them.  [C:6:0:0]Stockpiles[C:7:0:0] are crucial to moving supplies around your fortress where they are needed.[B][C:6:0:0]Stockpiles[C:7:0:0] are placed with the [C:5:0:1]Stockpile[C:7:0:0] button (highlighted.)  Click it now.
document_translation: 马车上的物资有被野外生物抢走的风险！  是时候在地下建造一个[C:6:0:0]储物处[C:7:0:0]并开始卸货了。  [C:6:0:0]储物处[C:7:0:0]对于在要塞中配给物资到需要的地方至关重要。[B]你可以通过点击[C:5:0:1]储物处[C:7:0:0]按钮（已高亮）来圈选一个[C:6:0:0]储物处[C:7:0:0]。  下面请先点击这个按钮。

document: Click the add button, and click two corners of a rectangle somewhere safe to place your pile.  [C:6:0:0]Stockpiles[C:7:0:0] can be placed both on the surface and underground.  Once the pile is placed, click [C:5:0:1]Accept[C:7:0:0] and select the [C:5:0:1]All[C:7:0:0] option.
document_translation: 点击菜单中带有加号的按钮，然后在一个安全的矩形区域依次点击两个角来圈选你的储物处的规划位置。  [C:6:0:0]储物处[C:7:0:0]既可以规划在地表也可以规划在地下。  在你完成规划后，点击[C:5:0:1]接受[C:7:0:0]并选择[C:5:0:1]所有[C:7:0:0]选项。

document: If unpaused, your workers should start unloading the wagon into the [C:6:0:0]Stockpile[C:7:0:0].  [B]Later you may want to customize your [C:6:0:0]Stockpiles[C:7:0:0] by clicking on them and pressing the [C:5:0:1]Custom[C:7:0:0] button to forbid certain categories, like [C:5:0:1]Refuse[C:7:0:0] for example.  A separate [C:6:0:0]Refuse Stockpile[C:7:0:0] is a good idea to keep your fortress clean.[B]If the [C:5:0:1]Stockpile[C:7:0:0] menu is still open, you can close it now by right-clicking.  Right-clicking can always be used to close most menus, as well as [KEY:3].
document_translation: 在解除暂停后，你的工人应该会开始从马车上卸货并搬到[C:6:0:0]储物处[C:7:0:0]中。  [B]以后你可能会想要自定义你的[C:6:0:0]储物处[C:7:0:0]，你可以点击一个规划好的[C:6:0:0]储物处[C:7:0:0]然后点击[C:5:0:1]自定义[C:7:0:0]按钮来禁止某些类别的物资，比方说[C:5:0:1]垃圾[C:7:0:0]。  设置一个单独的[C:6:0:0]垃圾储物处[C:7:0:0]通常是保持你要塞整洁的一个好主意。[B]如果现在[C:5:0:1]储物处[C:7:0:0]的菜单仍然开着，你可以通过鼠标右键关闭它了。  鼠标右键通常可以关闭绝大多数菜单，当然你也可以使用键盘上的 [KEY:3] 键。

title: Woodcutting
document: With shelter ready underground, it's time to build.  First you need building materials, like [C:6:0:1]Wood[C:7:0:0] or [C:6:0:1]Boulders[C:7:0:0].  [B]Before you start chopping down trees you may want to create a dedicated [C:6:0:0]Wood Stockpile[C:7:0:0].  [C:2:0:0]Haulers[C:7:0:0] will also drop [C:6:0:1]Wood[C:7:0:0] in your [C:6:0:0]All Stockpile[C:7:0:0] unless you turn it off in the [C:5:0:1]Custom Stockpile Menu[C:7:0:0].[B]When you are ready, open the [C:5:0:1]Woodcutting[C:7:0:0] menu and designate the trunk of a tree on the surface.  Make sure your woodcutter can walk to the designated location.
document_translation: 当你地下的基地准备好后，就可以开始扩建了。  首先你需要收集些建筑材料，比如[C:6:0:1]木材[C:7:0:0]或[C:6:0:1]石材[C:7:0:0]。  [B]在你开始砍你可能想要创建一个独立的[C:6:0:0]木材储物处[C:7:0:0]。  除非你在[C:6:0:0]全部储物处[C:7:0:0]的[C:5:0:1]自定义储物处菜单[C:7:0:0]中关闭[C:6:0:1]木材[C:7:0:0]选项，否则[C:2:0:0]搬运工[C:7:0:0]也可能会将掉落的[C:6:0:1]木材[C:7:0:0]放入其中。[B]当你准备好后，打开[C:5:0:1]伐木[C:7:0:0]菜单并指定地面上一棵树的树干。  请确保你的伐木工能够走到你所指定的位置。

document: Now we just need to wait for the woodcutter to chop down the tree.  If the fallen logs are accessible, everyone will help store them in the [C:6:0:0]Stockpile[C:7:0:0].  [B]You can right click to close [C:5:0:1]Woodcutting[C:7:0:0] mode.  Right clicking closes most menus.[B]If all of your [C:6:0:0]Stockpiles[C:7:0:0] are full, go ahead and place another one.
document_translation: 现在我们只需等待伐木工砍倒树木。  如果木材掉落在了矮人可以触及的地方，每个矮人都可以帮忙将它们搬运到规划好的[C:6:0:0]储物处[C:7:0:0]中。  [B]你可以通过鼠标右键关闭[C:5:0:1]伐木[C:7:0:0]模式。  别忘了鼠标右键通常可以关闭绝大多数菜单。[B]如果你的所有的[C:6:0:0]储物处[C:7:0:0]都满了，可以再规划一个。

title: Building
document: Now that you have the building materials it's time to start building.  [B][C:6:0:0]Workshops[C:7:0:0] are one of many buildings you can place with the highlighted [C:5:0:1]Build[C:7:0:0] button.  Click it now.
document_translation: 现在你已经有了需要的建筑材料，开始造吧。  [B][C:6:0:0]工坊[C:7:0:0]是你可以通过闪烁的[C:5:0:1]建造[C:7:0:0]按钮规划的众多建筑之一。  下面请先点击这个按钮。

document: Most [C:6:0:0]Workshops[C:7:0:0] require building material, such as [C:6:0:1]Wood[C:7:0:0] or [C:6:0:1]Boulders[C:7:0:0].  If you have some [C:6:0:1]Wood[C:7:0:0] stockpiled, you'll be able to place a [C:6:0:0]Carpenter's Workshop[C:7:0:0].  Click [C:5:0:1]Workshops[C:7:0:0] -> [C:5:0:1]Carpenter[C:7:0:0] and place the shop in an empty area on the surface or underground.
document_translation: 大多数[C:6:0:0]工坊[C:7:0:0]需要建筑材料，例如[C:6:0:1]木材[C:7:0:0]或[C:6:0:1]石材[C:7:0:0]。  如果你有一些[C:6:0:1]木材[C:7:0:0]储备，你就可以规划建造一个[C:6:0:0]木匠工坊[C:7:0:0]。  点击[C:5:0:1]工坊[C:7:0:0] -> [C:5:0:1]木匠[C:7:0:0]然后在地表或地下的空地规划建造这个工坊。

document: When unpaused, a worker should now build the [C:6:0:0]Workshop[C:7:0:0].[B]Once the worker is done, click on the building to select it.
document_translation: 在解除暂停后，工人应该会开始建造这个[C:6:0:0]工坊[C:7:0:0]。[B]当工人完成建造后，点击这个建筑以选中它。

document: Your industrious citizens will perform any task added to the [C:6:0:0]Workshop[C:7:0:0].  Most objects that are placed, like [C:6:0:1]Doors[C:7:0:0] and [C:6:0:1]Furniture[C:7:0:0], must first be built in a [C:6:0:0]Workshop[C:7:0:0].  [B][C:6:0:1]Furniture[C:7:0:0] created at the [C:6:0:0]Carpenter's Workshop[C:7:0:0] usually takes one [C:6:0:1]Wood[C:7:0:0] to build.  Add a task and make a [C:6:0:1]Bed[C:7:0:0].  Chop down more trees if necessary.  Unpause and wait for the [C:6:0:1]Bed[C:7:0:0] to be completed.
document_translation: 你勤劳的矮人将会执行添加到[C:6:0:0]工坊[C:7:0:0]的任何任务。  大多数像[C:6:0:1]门[C:7:0:0]和[C:6:0:1]家具[C:7:0:0]这样的可以放置的物品必须先在[C:6:0:0]工坊[C:7:0:0]中制作。  [B]在[C:6:0:0]木匠工坊[C:7:0:0]中，[C:6:0:1]家具[C:7:0:0]通常需要一块[C:6:0:1]木材[C:7:0:0]来制作。  现在添加一个制作[C:6:0:1]床[C:7:0:0]的任务。  如有需要，继续砍伐更多树木。  解除暂停并等待[C:6:0:1]床[C:7:0:0]制作完成。

document: Now that you have a [C:6:0:1]Bed[C:7:0:0] you can place in it the fortress.  Use the [C:5:0:1]Build[C:7:0:0] menu to place it in a room underground, just like the [C:6:0:0]Workshop[C:7:0:0].  Dig a new room first if you like.  [B][C:5:0:1]Beds[C:7:0:0] are found in the [C:5:0:1]Furniture[C:7:0:0] category.  Unlike [C:6:0:0]Workshops[C:7:0:0], [C:6:0:0]Beds[C:7:0:0] must be placed underground.
document_translation: 现在你已经制作好了一张可以放置在要塞中的[C:6:0:1]床[C:7:0:0]。  使用[C:5:0:1]建造[C:7:0:0]菜单像规划[C:6:0:0]工坊[C:7:0:0]那样将它放置在地下的房间中。  如果愿意你可以先挖一个新的房间。  [B][C:5:0:1]床[C:7:0:0]可以在[C:5:0:1]家具[C:7:0:0]类别中找到。  与[C:6:0:0]工坊[C:7:0:0]不同，[C:6:0:0]床[C:7:0:0]必须放置在地下。

document: With a [C:6:0:0]Bed[C:7:0:0] placed, your workers will have somewhere to sleep.  Later you can create a room with a [C:6:0:0]Door[C:7:0:0] and use the [C:5:0:1]Zones[C:7:0:0] menu to assign an official [C:3:0:0]Bedroom[C:7:0:0] for each resident.
document_translation: 在放置好了[C:6:0:0]床[C:7:0:0]以后，你的工人们就有了睡觉的地方了。  以后你可以建造一个带[C:6:0:0]门[C:7:0:0]的房间并使用[C:5:0:1]区划[C:7:0:0]菜单给每个矮人都分配一个正式的[C:3:0:0]卧室[C:7:0:0]。

title: Information sheets
document: The rest of the interface is now enabled.[B]You can click on [C:2:0:0]Creatures[C:7:0:0] and [C:6:0:1]Items[C:7:0:0] just as you can click on [C:6:0:0]Buildings[C:7:0:0] to get more information about them. Click on a [C:2:0:0]Resident[C:7:0:0] to see their needs, inventory, thoughts, relations, and more. You can also access information from the [C:5:0:1]Citizens[C:7:0:0] button.
document_translation: 其余的界面现在已经启用了。[B]你可以像点击[C:6:0:0]建筑[C:7:0:0]一样点击[C:2:0:0]生物[C:7:0:0]和[C:6:0:1]物品[C:7:0:0]来获取它们的更多信息。点击一位[C:2:0:0]居民[C:7:0:0]以查看他们的需求、库存、想法、关系等。你也可以通过[C:5:0:1]公民[C:7:0:0]按钮访问这些信息。

document: You can click on [C:2:0:0]Creatures[C:7:0:0] and [C:6:0:1]Items[C:7:0:0] just as you can click on [C:6:0:0]Buildings[C:7:0:0] to get more information about them. Click on a [C:2:0:0]Resident[C:7:0:0] to see their needs, inventory, thoughts, relations, and more. You can also access information from the [C:5:0:1]Citizens[C:7:0:0] button.
document_translation: 你可以像点击[C:6:0:0]建筑[C:7:0:0]一样点击[C:2:0:0]生物[C:7:0:0]和[C:6:0:1]物品[C:7:0:0]来获取它们的更多信息。点击一位[C:2:0:0]居民[C:7:0:0]以查看他们的需求、库存、想法、关系等。你也可以通过[C:5:0:1]公民[C:7:0:0]按钮访问这些信息。

document: Feel free to pause and check out the information.[B]Right click to dismiss the information sheet.
document_translation: 你可以随时暂停游戏来查看这些信息。[B]点击鼠标右键以关闭信息窗口。

title: Alerts
document: Important and sometimes urgent information is given as alerts on the left side of the screen. There has been one already![B]Hover over an alert icon to see the information. Left click on an alert for recentering options, and right click to dismiss an alert.
document_translation: 重要和有些紧急的信息将会以警报的形式显示在屏幕左侧。有一个警报已经出现了！[B]你可以将鼠标悬停在警报图标上以查看详情，左键点击警报后可以展示用来定位来源的按钮，右键点击警报则可以关闭它。

document: Important and sometimes urgent information is given as alerts on the left side of the screen. There have been several already![B]Hover over an alert icon to see the information. Left click on an alert for recentering options, and right click to dismiss an alert.
document_translation: 重要和有些紧急的信息将会以警报的形式显示在屏幕左侧。有几个警报已经出现了！[B]你可以将鼠标悬停在警报图标上以查看详情，左键点击警报后可以展示用来定位来源的按钮，右键点击警报则可以关闭它。

title: Preparing for the Caravan
document: You may need supplies before the coming of winter. To trade with the autumn caravan, you must build a [C:6:0:0]Trade Depot[C:7:0:0] from the [C:5:0:1]Build[C:7:0:0] menu.[B]You need something of value to trade. [C:6:0:1]Crafts[C:7:0:0] are an easy way to make a lot of trade goods quickly. Make the appropriate workshop with [C:5:0:1]Workshops[C:7:0:0] -> [C:5:0:1]Crafts[C:7:0:0]. [B]An obvious material to use to make the crafts is rock. If you dig down enough layers you will find a near infinite amount of [C:6:0:1]Boulders[C:7:0:0] of various kinds as well as some [C:6:0:1]Rough Gems[C:7:0:0] if you are lucky.[B][C:6:0:1]Gems[C:7:0:0] can be [C:3:0:1]Cut[C:7:0:0] at the [C:6:0:0]Jeweler's Workshop[C:7:0:0].  [C:3:0:1]Encrust[C:7:0:0] them on [C:6:0:1]Crafts[C:7:0:0] and other items to add even more value.
document_translation: 在冬季到来之前你可能需要屯些物资。要与秋季商队进行交易，你必须从[C:5:0:1]建造[C:7:0:0]菜单中建造一个[C:6:0:0]贸易站[C:7:0:0]。[B]你需要一些有价值的物品来进行交易。[C:6:0:1]工艺品[C:7:0:0]是快速制作大量交易用商品的简单方法。使用[C:5:0:1]工坊[C:7:0:0] -> [C:5:0:1]工艺品[C:7:0:0]来建造制作工艺品的工坊。[B]石头是一种可以用来制作工艺品显而易见的材料。如果你挖的足够深，你将会找到近乎无限量的各种类型的[C:6:0:1]石材[C:7:0:0]，如果够幸运的话你还可以找到一些[C:6:0:1]粗制的宝石[C:7:0:0]。[B][C:6:0:1]宝石[C:7:0:0]可以在[C:6:0:0]珠宝工坊[C:7:0:0]中进行[C:3:0:1]切割[C:7:0:0]。  将它们[C:3:0:1]镶嵌[C:7:0:0]到[C:6:0:1]工艺品[C:7:0:0]和其他物品上可以进一步增加它们的价值。

title: Just the beginning
document: There's a lot more to learn![B]As you enter new menus, there will be information and tips.[B]The [C:5:0:1]Help[C:7:0:0] button at the top of the screen contains more guides. Click it now, and this tutorial will be concluded.
document_translation: 这还有很多知识需要你学习！[B]当你进入一些新菜单时，可能会有信息和提示出现。[B]屏幕顶部的[C:5:0:1]帮助[C:7:0:0]按钮中包含了更多的指引。现在点击它，然后这个教程到此就结束了。

title: Zones
document: [C:3:0:0]Zones[C:7:0:0] are areas you designate where your citizens will work, socialize, rest, or perform specific duties. There are several kinds of [C:3:0:0]Zones[C:7:0:0], which you can see in the panel on the left.[B][C:3:0:0]Zones[C:7:0:0] are placed much like [C:6:0:0]Stockpiles[C:7:0:0]. Unlike [C:6:0:0]Stockpiles[C:7:0:0], multiple [C:3:0:0]Zones[C:7:0:0] can overlap.[B]Certain [C:3:0:0]Zones[C:7:0:0] like [C:3:0:0]Bedrooms[C:7:0:0] can be placed several at a time. Just make sure you have the correct [C:6:0:0]Furniture[C:7:0:0] placed in the rooms with [C:6:0:0]Doors[C:7:0:0] or vertical entries separating each room before you begin.
document_translation: [C:3:0:0]功能区[C:7:0:0]是由你指定的让你的公民工作、社交、休息或履行特定职能的场所。[C:3:0:0]功能区[C:7:0:0]有许多不同种类，你可以在左侧的面板中查看。[B][C:3:0:0]功能区[C:7:0:0]放置起来很像[C:6:0:0]储存区[C:7:0:0]。不同于[C:6:0:0]储存区[C:7:0:0]的是, 多个[C:3:0:0]功能区[C:7:0:0]可以相互重叠。[B]特定的[C:3:0:0]功能区[C:7:0:0]如 [C:3:0:0]卧室[C:7:0:0]可以一次性放置好几个。只要你确保房间内放置有正确的[C:6:0:0]家具[C:7:0:0]，并配有[C:6:0:0]门[C:7:0:0]，或是用垂直方向的出入口分隔出了要划分的各个房间。

title: Burrows
document: [C:1:0:0]Burrows[C:7:0:0] are work and living areas where citizens can be assigned. Workers will try to limit their tasks to the confines of the [C:1:0:0]Burrow[C:7:0:0], but they will sometimes form paths which pass through other areas.[B][C:1:0:0]Burrows[C:7:0:0] can be suspended and unsuspended freely.  When a [C:1:0:0]Burrow[C:7:0:0] is suspended, assigned citizens will ignore it.[B]It can be useful to assign all of your civilians to a safe emergency [C:1:0:0]Burrow[C:7:0:0] which you activate in case of intruders.
document_translation: [C:1:0:0]活动区[C:7:0:0]是可以指定给矮人公民工作和生活的区域。矮人们会试图将他们的任务限制在[C:1:0:0]活动区[C:7:0:0]的范围内进行，但他们有时会采用活动区以外区域的路径。[B][C:1:0:0]活动区[C:7:0:0]可以自由地停用和启用。  当[C:1:0:0]活动区[C:7:0:0]被停用时，被指定到此区的矮人将无视它的限制。[B]把所有的平民指定到一个安全的[C:1:0:0]活动区[C:7:0:0]会很有用，你可以在诸如入侵者出现等紧急情况时启用。

title: Minecart routes
document: [C:6:0:1]Minecarts[C:7:0:0] and [C:6:0:0]Tracks[C:7:0:0] are a convenient way to move a lot of objects around the fortress quickly, though they take a little effort to prepare. One [C:6:0:1]Minecart[C:7:0:0] can be assigned to each route, and workers will move the vehicle from [C:6:0:0]Track Stop[C:7:0:0] to [C:6:0:0]Track Stop[C:7:0:0] according to conditions you specify.[B]Each [C:6:0:0]Track Stop[C:7:0:0] must be linked to a [C:6:0:0]Stockpile[C:7:0:0] for [C:6:0:1]Items[C:7:0:0] to be put on or removed from the [C:6:0:1]Minecart[C:7:0:0].[B]Only one condition needs to be satisfied for the [C:6:0:1]Minecart[C:7:0:0] to move to the next [C:6:0:0]Track Stop[C:7:0:0].[B][C:6:0:1]Minecarts[C:7:0:0] that move too quickly around corners will spill their contents. When a route has a steep descent, consider using powered [C:6:0:0]Rollers[C:7:0:0], extra curves, track "stops" between [C:6:0:0]Stops[C:7:0:0] with various friction settings, or a worker to guide the vehicle.
document_translation: [C:6:0:1]矿车[C:7:0:0]和[C:6:0:0]轨道[C:7:0:0]是快速在要塞各处间移动大量物体的便捷方式，尽管它们需要花一点功夫准备。每条路线可以分配一辆[C:6:0:1]矿车[C:7:0:0]，工人将根据您指定的条件将矿车从一个[C:6:0:0]轨道站点[C:7:0:0]移动到另一个[C:6:0:0]轨道站点[C:7:0:0]（可以是同一个）。[B]每个[C:6:0:0]轨道站点[C:7:0:0]必须链接到一个[C:6:0:0]储物处[C:7:0:0]，以便[C:6:0:1]物品[C:7:0:0]可以装载到[C:6:0:1]矿车[C:7:0:0]中或从[C:6:0:1]矿车[C:7:0:0]中卸货。[B]只需设置一个条件以让[C:6:0:1]矿车[C:7:0:0]在满足条件时移动到下一个[C:6:0:0]轨道站点[C:7:0:0]。[B][C:6:0:1]在拐角处移动过快的矿车[C:7:0:0]会洒出里面的东西。当路线有陡坡时，考虑使用有供能的[C:6:0:0]滚链[C:7:0:0]、额外的弯道、[C:6:0:0]轨道站点[C:7:0:0]之间只提供摩擦而不使矿车停留的“轨道站点”，或由工人引导车辆。

title: Stocks
document: Here you can see every [C:6:0:1]Item[C:7:0:0] in the fortress. Click on category headings to collapse and expand them. [B]If you don't have a [C:5:0:0]Bookkeeper[C:7:0:0], or they don't have an [C:3:0:0]Office[C:7:0:0] to work in, numbers may be approximate.
document_translation: 在这里你可以看到要塞里的每一个[C:6:0:1]物品[C:7:0:0]。单击类别名以折叠或展开它们。[B]如果你没有[C:5:0:0]簿记员[C:7:0:0]，或者他们没有[C:3:0:0]办公室[C:7:0:0]可供工作，那么数字可能只是一个估值。

title: Work details
document: Work details are one way you can control which workers do which tasks, and they are the only way to assign certain tasks like mining, woodcutting, hunting, and fishing. [B]Generally, almost every task will be available for every citizen, but you can both restrict both citizens and tasks. Citizens are restricted by using their [C:5:0:1]Specialization[C:7:0:0] button. Tasks are restricted by setting their work detail to [C:5:0:1]"Only selected do this"[C:7:0:0].[B]If a task does not have a default work detail, you can create a custom work detail.  Once you assign citizens to the task, you can then set [C:5:0:1]"Only selected do this"[C:7:0:0] if you want to restrict it.
document_translation: 工作细节界面是控制哪些工人执行哪些任务的其中一种方式，也是指定采矿、伐木、狩猎和捕鱼等特定任务的唯一方式。[B]一般来说，每个公民都可以做几乎所有任务，但从公民方和任务方都可以分别进行限制。公民可以使用[C:5:0:1]专业[C:7:0:0]按钮进行限制。任务可通过将其工作详细信息设置为[C:5:0:1]“只有被选择的公民可做”[C:7:0:0]进行限制。[B]如果任务没有默认工作详细信息，则可以创建自定义工作详细信息，在你将公民指定给该任务后，你就可以在你想限制该任务时设置为[C:5:0:1]“只有被选择的公民可做”[C:7:0:0]。

title: Nobles and administrators
document: Here you can view your nobles, as well as assign your administrators, military leaders, and other officials.[B][C:5:0:0]Militia Commanders[C:7:0:0] are assigned here. Once the first leader is assigned, subsequent [C:5:0:0]Captain[C:7:0:0] positions will appear. These can also be assigned from the squad menu.[B]Certain important functions in your fortress can only be performed by assigned administrators, such as the [C:5:0:0]Manager[C:7:0:0] and [C:5:0:0]Bookkeeper[C:7:0:0]. Once they are assigned, you can create work orders, run a [C:1:0:1]Hospital[C:7:0:0], and count and appraise your hoard.[B]Nobles and certain administrators require rooms, and some may also make demands.
document_translation: 在该界面，你可以查看你治下的贵族，并指定管理员、军队指挥官和其他官员。[B][C:5:0:0]军事指挥官[C:7:0:0]职位可以在这里分配。一旦分配了第一个指挥官，后续的[C:5:0:0]队长[C:7:0:0]职位将会出现，这些职位也可以在军事分队菜单中分配。[B]某些重要职能只能由分配好的管理员执行，比如[C:5:0:0]经理[C:7:0:0]和[C:5:0:0]记账员[C:7:0:0]。一旦他们被分配，你就可以创建工作订单、运转[C:1:0:1]医院[C:7:0:0]，以及统计和评估你的物资财富。[B]贵族和某些管理员需要专门的房间，有些人或职位可能还有额外的要求。

title: Justice
document: If you have a law enforcement administrator like a [C:5:0:0]Sheriff[C:7:0:0] or [C:5:0:0]Captain of the Guard[C:7:0:0], witnesses of crimes will make reports, which find their way here. Certain crimes are indicative of larger problems, so you should pay attention to them, and affected victims and family members get upset if crime is ignored.[B]It's up to you to choose whom to convict. All available witness information is presented for each case. You can also interrogate suspects. This is particularly important for schemes where the witnesses might not have the full story.[B]It is recommended to place a certain number of [C:6:0:0]Cages[C:7:0:0] and [C:6:0:0]Chains[C:7:0:0] and assign them to a [C:3:0:0]Dungeon[C:7:0:0] zone. Officers may opt for physical punishment if they cannot carry out custodial sentences.
document_translation: 如果你有像[C:5:0:0]警长[C:7:0:0]或[C:5:0:0]警卫队队长[C:7:0:0]这样的执法管理员，犯罪行为的目击者会提交报告给他们，并显示在该界面。某些犯罪行为的背后可能隐含着更严重的问题，因此你应该多加注意。如果犯罪行为被忽视，受害者和他们的家属会感到不满。[B]谁应被定罪是由你决定的。每个案件的所有可用目击信息都会被呈现。你也可以对嫌疑人进行审问，这对于目击信息不全面充分的案件尤为重要。[B]建议你放置一定数量的[C:6:0:0]笼子[C:7:0:0]和[C:6:0:0]链条[C:7:0:0]并将它们所在区域指定为[C:3:0:0]地牢[C:7:0:0]功能区。如果拘禁判决没有地牢可执行，则执法人员可能会选择体罚。

title: Squads
document: This is the squad menu. Here you can create squads, fill their positions, assign equipment and schedules, and give specific orders.[B]It is recommended that you prepare a squad and get them training as soon as you can. You have no idea what's lurking out there.
document_translation: 这是军事分队菜单。在这里，你可以创建分队、分配分队中的位置、调整装备和安排日程，还可以下达具体的命令。[B]建议你尽快配置好一个分队并让他们开始训练。有备，则无患。

title: The World
document: The world created at the beginning of the game is active, and others may take an interest in your outpost as it grows. Stolen [C:6:0:1]Artifacts[C:7:0:0] and kidnapped citizens can be recovered by preparing missions from this screen. [B]You can also cause trouble if you'd like to raid your neighbors. Raids are created by clicking on any site not belonging to your civilization.
document_translation: 在游戏开始时创建的世界是活跃的，随着你的要塞逐渐发展，其他势力可能会对其产生兴趣。被盗的[C:6:0:1]神器[C:7:0:0]和被绑架的公民可以在这个界面中通过开展任务来找回。[B]如果你想制造点麻烦，你也可以在此处发起对邻居的袭击行动，这能通过点击任何不属于你文明的地点来进行。

title: Work orders
document: Work orders are used to automate [C:3:0:1]Tasks[C:7:0:0] in [C:6:0:0]Workshops[C:7:0:0]. These work orders are set to complete a certain number of [C:3:0:1]Tasks[C:7:0:0] and can be given start conditions.[B]For instance, you can create an order to [C:3:0:1]Make Wooden Bins[C:7:0:0] if you are out of empty ones, to [C:3:0:1]Brew Drinks[C:7:0:0] if you are running low, or to [C:3:0:1]Make Five Statues[C:7:0:0] every month.[B]You can limit work orders to a number of [C:6:0:0]Workshops[C:7:0:0]. You can also create work orders at specific [C:6:0:0]Workshops[C:7:0:0] from their building sheet. The system is reasonably powerful and you can eventually automate almost all of your production if you wish.
document_translation: 工作订单用于制定自动化生产[C:3:0:1]任务[C:7:0:0]并下发给[C:6:0:0]工坊[C:7:0:0]。这些工作订单可被设定为一次性完成一定数量的[C:3:0:1]任务[C:7:0:0]，并可以设定订单启动条件。[B]例如，如果要塞里面没有空储物箱了，你就可以创建一个订单以[C:3:0:1]制作木制储物箱[C:7:0:0]；如果饮料快见底了，可以创建一个订单以[C:3:0:1]酿造饮品[C:7:0:0]；或者干脆下个每月[C:3:0:1]制作五个雕像[C:7:0:0]的订单。[B]你可以将工作订单限制在一定数量的[C:6:0:0]工坊[C:7:0:0]中。你也可以在特定的[C:6:0:0]工坊[C:7:0:0]的建筑页面上创建工作订单。这个系统相当强大，如果你愿意，最终你治下的几乎所有生产都可以实现自动化。

title: Survival
document: In order to keep your citizens alive in the unforgiving wilderness they will need shelter, drink, and food.[B]Use the arrow at the top of this window to minimize the tutorial when it obscures your view.
document_translation: 为了让你的居民在严酷的荒野中生存，他们需要避难所、饮水和食物。[B]如果本教程界面遮挡了你的视野，你可以通过按下顶部的箭头以最小化本窗口。

document: [C:7:0:1]Shelter[C:7:0:0][B]By now you should have a room underground where your residents can hide from the creatures above. To make sure they spend their free time down there you will need to use the [C:5:0:1]Zones[C:7:0:0] menu to create a [C:3:0:0]Meeting Area[C:7:0:0]. Later you may try the [C:5:0:1]Burrows[C:7:0:0] menu to create a safe place for your civilians to hide when real trouble comes.
document_translation: [C:7:0:1]避难所[C:7:0:0][B]到现在为止，你应该已经有了一个地下空间，供你的居民躲避地上的生物。为了确保他们在空闲时间也待在地下空间，你需要使用[C:5:0:1]功能区[C:7:0:0]菜单创建一个[C:3:0:0]集会区[C:7:0:0]。稍后你可以尝试使用[C:5:0:1]活动区[C:7:0:0]菜单，为你的平民创建一个安全的藏身之处，以应对真正的危险。

document: [C:7:0:1]Labor[C:7:0:0][B]Some essential tasks must be assigned from the [C:5:0:1]Labor[C:7:0:0] menu. Click here and make sure you have a [C:2:0:0]Miner[C:7:0:0], [C:2:0:0]Woodcutter[C:7:0:0], and [C:2:0:0]Fisherdwarf[C:7:0:0]. [B]If you haven't suffered any casualties, you should have these labors assigned already. But if one of these brave workers falls, you'll need to assign somebody to these duties.
document_translation: [C:7:0:1]劳动[C:7:0:0][B]一些关键任务必须在[C:5:0:1]劳动[C:7:0:0]界面进行分配。点击这里并确保你至少有一个[C:2:0:0]矿工[C:7:0:0]、一个[C:2:0:0]伐木工[C:7:0:0]和一个[C:2:0:0]钓鱼矮人[C:7:0:0]。[B]如果你直到现在还未有任何矮人损失，这几个劳动应该已经在一开始就分配好了。但如果这些一开始分配好的勇敢工人其中有人倒下了，你就需要为这些工作重新分配人员。

document: [C:7:0:1]Drink[C:7:0:0][B]There are two ways to make drinks for your residents.[B]The main way is by brewing alcohol. This is done by building a [C:6:0:0]Still[C:7:0:0] from the [C:5:0:1]Build[C:7:0:0] menu using [C:5:0:1]Workshops[C:7:0:0] -> [C:5:0:1]Farming[C:7:0:0] -> [C:5:0:1]Still[C:7:0:0]. [B]Once the [C:6:0:0]Still[C:7:0:0] is constructed, click on it and add the task [C:3:0:1]Brew Drink from Plant (or fruit)[C:7:0:0].  If you have no suitable [C:6:0:1]Plants[C:7:0:0], you may try [C:5:0:1]Planting[C:7:0:0] or [C:5:0:1]Gathering[C:7:0:0]. The task also requires a [C:6:0:1]Barrel[C:7:0:0] from the [C:6:0:0]Carpenter's Workshop[C:7:0:0]. [B]If you survive until the caravan comes you may also trade for [C:6:0:1]Drinks[C:7:0:0] or [C:6:0:1]Plants[C:7:0:0] there.  The number of [C:6:0:1]Drink[C:7:0:0] rations can be seen at the top of the screen.[B]Absent alcohol and in warmer weather, you can designate a [C:3:0:0]Water Source[C:7:0:0] from the [C:5:0:1]Zones[C:7:0:0] menu at a river or pond, so that your residents have water to drink.  You'll want one of these anyway for other purposes, like cleaning and certain [C:6:0:0]Workshop[C:7:0:0] tasks.  You may find water underground.
document_translation: [C:7:0:1]饮品[C:7:0:0][B]有两种方法可以为要塞居民制造饮品。[B]主要的方法是酿造酒精。通过在[C:5:0:1]建筑[C:7:0:0]菜单中选择[C:5:0:1]工坊[C:7:0:0]->[C:5:0:1]农业[C:7:0:0]->[C:5:0:1]蒸馏器[C:7:0:0]来建造一个[C:6:0:0]蒸馏器[C:7:0:0]。 [B]当 [C:6:0:0]蒸馏器[C:7:0:0]建好后，点击它并添加任务“[C:3:0:1]从植物（或水果）中酿造饮品[C:7:0:0]”。如果没有合适的[C:6:0:1]植物[C:7:0:0]，你可以尝试[C:5:0:1]种植[C:7:0:0]或[C:5:0:1]采集[C:7:0:0]以获取。这个任务还需要一个[C:6:0:1]圆桶[C:7:0:0]，它可以从[C:6:0:0]木匠工坊[C:7:0:0]中生产。[B]如果你能撑到商队到来，你也可以交易获取[C:6:0:1]饮品[C:7:0:0]或可酿造的[C:6:0:1]植物[C:7:0:0]。饮品的储量可以在屏幕顶部看到。[B]天气较暖时，如果酒精实在短缺，你可以设置一个[C:5:0:1]区域[C:7:0:0]菜单中的[C:3:0:0]取水处[C:7:0:0]到河流或者池塘地块上，以确保你的居民有水可饮。反正为了其他用途你无论如何也得设置一个取水处，比如清洁，以及某些[C:6:0:0]工坊[C:7:0:0]中的任务。你也可能会在地下找到水源。

title: Planting
document: There's some food on the embark [C:6:0:0]Wagon[C:7:0:0], and you can trade for food, but you can also grow your own. [B]The [C:6:0:0]Wagon[C:7:0:0] comes with some [C:6:0:1]Seeds[C:7:0:0], but as you might expect, these crops must be grown underground![B]Using [C:5:0:1]Mining[C:7:0:0] orders, you'll need to carve out a rectangular area underground for your [C:6:0:0]Farmplot[C:7:0:0]. [B]The underground rectangle must be near the surface, where there is soil (loam, clay, or sand.) One level down should suffice, before you hit rock. The highest mountain elevations do not have soil. [B]Make sure to leave the ceiling above intact so the underground soil doesn't receive any sunlight.
document_translation: 出发时自带的 [C:6:0:0]马车[C:7:0:0] 上有一些食物，你可以通过交易获取食物，但你也可以自己种植。[B]这辆 [C:6:0:0]马车[C:7:0:0] 配有一些 [C:6:0:1]种子[C:7:0:0]，但正跟你想得一样，这些作物必须在地下种植！[B]使用 [C:5:0:1]采矿[C:7:0:0] 命令，你需要在地下挖掘出一个矩形区域，用于放置 [C:6:0:0]农田[C:7:0:0]。[B]这个地下矩形区域必须靠近地表，有土壤（如壤土、粘土或沙土）。在你触及岩石之前，向下挖掘一层就足够了。最高山脉的海拔处没有土壤。[B]确保保留上方的天花板，以避免地下土壤接触阳光。

document: With a subterranean soil floor exposed, you can place an underground [C:6:0:0]Farmplot[C:7:0:0]. This isn't rich soil, but will suffice for now.  Dig deeper to find better soil. [B]Select [C:5:0:1]Farmplot[C:7:0:0] from the [C:5:0:1]Build[C:7:0:0] menu.  It's in [C:5:0:1]Workshops[C:7:0:0] -> [C:5:0:1]Farming[C:7:0:0] -> [C:5:0:1]Farmplot[C:7:0:0].  Place the [C:6:0:0]Farmplot[C:7:0:0] on the subterranean soil.
document_translation: 在发掘出的地下土壤层上，你可以放置一片地下 [C:6:0:0]农田[C:7:0:0]。这样的土壤虽然不算富饶，但眼下也够用了。你可以继续挖掘，以找到条件更好的土壤。[B]从 [C:5:0:1]建筑[C:7:0:0] 菜单中选择 [C:5:0:1]农田[C:7:0:0]。它位于 [C:5:0:1]工坊[C:7:0:0] -> [C:5:0:1]农业[C:7:0:0] -> [C:5:0:1]农田[C:7:0:0]。将 [C:6:0:0]农田[C:7:0:0] 放置在地下土壤地块上。

document: You need to select the crops to be grown each season. Click on the [C:6:0:0]Farmplot[C:7:0:0] you placed to pull up the [C:5:0:1]Farming[C:7:0:0] menu.[B][C:6:0:1]Plump Helmets[C:7:0:0] are edible and the default [C:6:0:0]Wagon[C:7:0:0] comes with [C:6:0:1]Plump Helmet Spawn[C:7:0:0], which are their "seeds".[B]Note that you can obtain aboveground [C:6:0:1]Seeds[C:7:0:0] from trade or by eating gathered [C:6:0:1]Plants[C:7:0:0], but aboveground farming exposes your [C:2:0:0]Planters[C:7:0:0] to dangers and the elements.
document_translation: 你需要选择每个季节要种植的作物。点击你建造的的 [C:6:0:0]农田[C:7:0:0] 以打开 [C:5:0:1]农业[C:7:0:0] 菜单。[B][C:6:0:1]肉盔菇[C:7:0:0] 是可食用的，默认的 [C:6:0:0]马车[C:7:0:0] 配备有 [C:6:0:1]肉盔菇菌种[C:7:0:0]，即它们的“种子”。[B]注意，你可以通过交易或食用采集的 [C:6:0:1]植物[C:7:0:0] 来获得地面上的 [C:6:0:1]种子[C:7:0:0]，但地面种植会使你的 [C:2:0:0]农夫[C:7:0:0] 暴露于危险和自然环境中。

document: Now your [C:2:0:0]Planters[C:7:0:0], those that can access both the [C:6:0:0]Farmplot[C:7:0:0] and the [C:6:0:1]Spawn[C:7:0:0], will plant the field, and after a period of growth, they'll be harvested. [B]If you'd like to focus a few of your citizens on farming, which gives skill benefits, you can assign them to the [C:2:0:0]Planters[C:7:0:0] work detail from the [C:5:0:1]Labor[C:7:0:0] menu. [B][C:6:0:1]Fertilizer[C:7:0:0] and skilled [C:2:0:0]Planters[C:7:0:0] have a direct impact on crop yield. These effects are more pronounced deep underground where you can locate the cavern biome and its rich soil.[B][C:6:0:1]Potash[C:7:0:0] is the fertilizer of choice, and it can be created in the [C:6:0:0]Ashery[C:7:0:0], using [C:6:0:1]Ash[C:7:0:0] from [C:6:0:1]Wood[C:7:0:0] burned in a [C:6:0:0]Wood Furnace[C:7:0:0].  A [C:3:0:0]Water Source[C:7:0:0] zone and a [C:6:0:1]Bucket[C:7:0:0] are also required. [C:6:0:1]Fertilizer[C:7:0:0] is not needed to farm.
document_translation: 现在你的 [C:2:0:0]农夫[C:7:0:0]，那些既能进入 [C:6:0:0]农田[C:7:0:0] 又能进入 [C:6:0:1]种子[C:7:0:0] 的工人，将会开始播种，经过一段生长时间后，作物就可以收获。[B]如果你希望让你的一部分矮人专注于农业来获得技能加成，你可以从 [C:5:0:1]劳动[C:7:0:0] 菜单中将一些公民分配到 [C:2:0:0]农夫[C:7:0:0] 的细分工作中。[B][C:6:0:1]肥料[C:7:0:0] 和熟练的 [C:2:0:0]农民[C:7:0:0] 对作物产量有直接影响。这些效果在地下深处更为明显，在那里你可以找到洞穴生物群落及其丰富的土壤。[B][C:6:0:1]草木灰[C:7:0:0] 就是肥料，可以在 [C:6:0:0]堆灰场[C:7:0:0] 中制作，制作肥料需要从 [C:6:0:1]木材[C:7:0:0] 燃烧中获得的 [C:6:0:1]灰烬[C:7:0:0]。还需要一个 [C:3:0:0]水源[C:7:0:0] 区域和一个 [C:6:0:1]桶[C:7:0:0]。 [C:6:0:1]肥料[C:7:0:0] 不是进行耕作的必需品。

title: Other food sources
document: [C:7:0:1]Fishing[C:7:0:0][B]If there is a river or pond nearby you may consider fishing.  If the water isn't frozen, a worker with the fishing labor assigned will begin fishing automatically.[B]You can optionally choose to designate a [C:3:0:0]Fishing[C:7:0:0] zone if you don't want your workers going far afield.[B]Remember, your workers do not eat raw fish!  You must build a [C:6:0:0]Fishery[C:7:0:0] to prepare them. Do this by selecting [C:5:0:1]Workshops[C:7:0:0] -> [C:5:0:1]Farming[C:7:0:0] -> [C:5:0:1]Fishery[C:7:0:0].
document_translation: [C:7:0:1]钓鱼[C:7:0:0][B]如果附近有河流或池塘，你可以考虑进行钓鱼。如果水没有结冰，分配了钓鱼劳动的工人将会自动开始钓鱼。[B]如果你不想让工人跑得太远，你可以选择指定一个 [C:3:0:0]钓鱼[C:7:0:0] 区域。[B]记住，你的工人不能吃生鱼！你必须建造一个 [C:6:0:0]渔场[C:7:0:0] 来处理鱼。通过选择 [C:5:0:1]工坊[C:7:0:0] -> [C:5:0:1]农业[C:7:0:0] -> [C:5:0:1]渔场[C:7:0:0] 来完成建造。

document: [C:7:0:1]Gathering[C:7:0:0][B]It is possible to survive by gathering plants outside.  Do this by selecting the [C:5:0:1]Gathering[C:7:0:0] order. Then draw a rectangle over the bushes you wish to search.
document_translation: [C:7:0:1]采集[C:7:0:0][B]你可以通过在要塞外面的草地上采集植物来生存。选择 [C:5:0:1]采集[C:7:0:0] 命令，然后在你希望搜索的灌木丛上绘制一个矩形。

document: [C:7:0:1]Butchering[C:7:0:0][B][C:6:0:1]Meat[C:7:0:0] from [C:2:0:0]Livestock[C:7:0:0] you slaughter is a source of food. [B]To slaughter an [C:2:0:0]Animal[C:7:0:0] you must first build a [C:6:0:0]Butcher's Shop[C:7:0:0]. Do this by selecting the building in [C:5:0:1]Workshops[C:7:0:0] -> [C:5:0:1]Farming[C:7:0:0] -> [C:5:0:1]Butcher[C:7:0:0]. [B]Once the shop is built, open the [C:5:0:1]Creatures[C:7:0:0] info menu.  From there select the [C:5:0:1]Pets/Livestock[C:7:0:0] tab. There you can select which [C:2:0:0]Animals[C:7:0:0] to slaughter.  You may need to minimize the tutorial to see the [C:5:0:1]Slaughter[C:7:0:0] buttons.[B]Note that some [C:2:0:0]Livestock[C:7:0:0] must eat vegetation to survive. To keep them alive use the [C:3:0:0]Pen/Pasture[C:7:0:0] zone from the [C:5:0:1]Zones[C:7:0:0] menu to select a section of grass and click the add button to assign the [C:2:0:0]Animals[C:7:0:0].
document_translation: [C:7:0:1]屠宰[C:7:0:0][B]从你屠宰的 [C:2:0:0]牲畜[C:7:0:0] 中获得的 [C:6:0:1]肉类[C:7:0:0] 是一种食物来源。[B]要屠宰 [C:2:0:0]动物[C:7:0:0]，你必须先建造 [C:6:0:0]屠宰场[C:7:0:0]。在 [C:5:0:1]工坊[C:7:0:0] -> [C:5:0:1]农业[C:7:0:0] -> [C:5:0:1]屠夫[C:7:0:0] 中选择该建筑来完成建造。[B]一旦屠宰场建好，就可以打开 [C:5:0:1]生物[C:7:0:0] 信息菜单，从那里选择 [C:5:0:1]宠物/牲畜[C:7:0:0] 标签。你可以在这里选择要屠宰的 [C:2:0:0]动物[C:7:0:0]。你可能需要最小化教程才能看到 [C:5:0:1]屠宰[C:7:0:0] 按钮。[B]注意，一些 [C:2:0:0]牲畜[C:7:0:0] 必须吃植物才能生存。为了保持它们的生命，使用 [C:3:0:0]圈舍/牧场[C:7:0:0] 区域，从 [C:5:0:1]区域[C:7:0:0] 菜单中选择一片草地，然后点击添加按钮将 [C:2:0:0]动物[C:7:0:0] 分配到那里。

title: Bins, bags, and barrels
document: If you find that your stockpiles are filling up too fast, you can create room by building [C:6:0:1]Bins[C:7:0:0], [C:6:0:1]Barrels[C:7:0:0], and [C:6:0:1]Bags[C:7:0:0].  [C:6:0:1]Barrels[C:7:0:0] are used to store [C:6:0:1]Food[C:7:0:0].  [C:6:0:1]Bags[C:7:0:0] are used to store [C:6:0:1]Seeds[C:7:0:0] (and some other things like [C:6:0:1]Sand[C:7:0:0]).  [C:6:0:1]Bins[C:7:0:0] hold just about everything else except [C:6:0:1]Furniture[C:7:0:0], [C:6:0:1]Wood[C:7:0:0] and [C:6:0:1]Boulders[C:7:0:0]. [B]The [C:6:0:0]Carpenter's Workshop[C:7:0:0] is the best place to make lightweight [C:6:0:1]Bins[C:7:0:0] and [C:6:0:1]Barrels[C:7:0:0], but they can also be made at the [C:6:0:0]Stoneworker's Shop[C:7:0:0] and the [C:6:0:0]Metalsmith's Forge[C:7:0:0].  [C:6:0:1]Bags[C:7:0:0] are created at the [C:6:0:0]Clothier's Shop[C:7:0:0] or the [C:6:0:0]Leatherworks[C:7:0:0].

title: Trade
document: When the caravan arrives at the [C:6:0:0]Trade Depot[C:7:0:0], you must click on the depot and select [C:5:0:1]"Bring Goods to Depot"[C:7:0:0]. Here you can select which goods you wish to trade.  After everyone has brought their goods you can select [C:5:0:1]"Trade"[C:7:0:0].  Don't worry if you have no [C:5:0:0]Broker[C:7:0:0], just select [C:5:0:1]"Anyone can Trade"[C:7:0:0].  You cannot trade until your [C:5:0:0]Broker[C:7:0:0] or another resident arrives at the depot.[B]When trading you select which goods you want from the list on the left, and which goods of yours to trade from the list on the right.  Then hit [C:5:0:1]"Trade"[C:7:0:0].  The trader will accept if the deal is fair and they can carry away the weight of the things you are selling.[B]Note that if you have a [C:5:0:0]Broker[C:7:0:0] the value of each good with be shown if their skill is high enough.
document_translation: 当商队到达 [C:6:0:0]贸易站[C:7:0:0] 时，你必须点击贸易站并选择 [C:5:0:1]“将物品送到贸易站”[C:7:0:0]。在这里，你可以选择你希望交易的物品。所有物品运送完毕后，你可以选择 [C:5:0:1]“交易”[C:7:0:0]。如果没有 [C:5:0:0]交易官[C:7:0:0]，也不用担心，只需选择 [C:5:0:1]“任何人都可以交易”[C:7:0:0]。在 [C:5:0:0]交易官[C:7:0:0] 或其他居民到达贸易站之前，你不能进行交易。[B]在交易时，你需要从左侧的列表中选择你想要的物品，从右侧的列表中选择你要交易的物品。然后点击 [C:5:0:1]“交易”[C:7:0:0]。如果交易公平，并且商人能够搬得动你出售的物品，他们就会接受交易。[B]注意，如果你有 [C:5:0:0]交易官[C:7:0:0]，且其技能足够高，每件物品的价值将会显示出来。

title: Offices and administrative work
document: In order for some functions to be used, like work orders or bookkeeping, [C:5:0:0]Administrators[C:7:0:0] must be assigned. To do this select the [C:5:0:1]Nobles and administrators[C:7:0:0] menu and click the add button to assign somebody. [B]Some [C:5:0:0]Administrators[C:7:0:0] will require [C:3:0:0]Offices[C:7:0:0] to perform their work. You can create these with [C:5:0:1]Zones[C:7:0:0] -> [C:5:0:1]Office[C:7:0:0]. The [C:3:0:0]Zone[C:7:0:0] you select must contain a [C:6:0:0]Chair[C:7:0:0], or you can paint a [C:3:0:0]Zone[C:7:0:0] and place a [C:6:0:0]Chair[C:7:0:0] later. Remember to assign the [C:5:0:0]Administrator[C:7:0:0] to the [C:3:0:0]Office[C:7:0:0].[B]Other nobles may appear or be assigned as the game progresses.  Use the [C:5:0:1]Nobles and administrators[C:7:0:0] menu to check their wants and needs.
document_translation: 为了使用一些功能，比如工作订单或记账，必须分配 [C:5:0:0]管理员[C:7:0:0]。为此，你需要选择 [C:5:0:1]贵族和管理员[C:7:0:0] 菜单，点击添加按钮来分配。[B]一些 [C:5:0:0]管理员[C:7:0:0] 需要 [C:3:0:0]办公室[C:7:0:0] 才能做他们对应的工作。你可以通过 [C:5:0:1]区域[C:7:0:0] -> [C:5:0:1]办公室[C:7:0:0] 来创建。你选择的 [C:3:0:0]区域[C:7:0:0] 里必须包含一个 [C:6:0:0]椅子[C:7:0:0]，或者你也可以先设置 [C:3:0:0]区域[C:7:0:0]，然后再放置 [C:6:0:0]椅子[C:7:0:0]。记得将 [C:5:0:0]管理员[C:7:0:0] 分配到 [C:3:0:0]办公室[C:7:0:0]。[B]随着游戏进展，会出现更多其它贵族，可以在 [C:5:0:1]贵族和管理员[C:7:0:0] 菜单检查他们的需求和要求。

title: Ore and smelting
document: In order to make [C:6:0:1]Metal Bars[C:7:0:0] for the [C:2:0:0]Metalsmith[C:7:0:0], you must smelt [C:6:0:1]Ore[C:7:0:0]. This can done at the [C:6:0:0]Smelter[C:7:0:0] which can be found under [C:5:0:1]Workshops[C:7:0:0] -> [C:5:0:1]Furnaces[C:7:0:0] -> [C:5:0:1]Smelter[C:7:0:0]. [C:6:0:1]Ore[C:7:0:0] is mined underground, below the soil layers.[B]If you have found magma you can build a [C:6:0:0]Magma Smelter[C:7:0:0] directly over it, otherwise you need [C:6:0:1]Fuel[C:7:0:0]. To get [C:6:0:1]Fuel[C:7:0:0] you need to make [C:6:0:1]Charcoal[C:7:0:0] with a [C:6:0:0]Wood Furnace[C:7:0:0], found at [C:5:0:1]Workshops[C:7:0:0] -> [C:5:0:1]Furnaces[C:7:0:0] -> [C:5:0:1]Wood Furnace[C:7:0:0]. You may switch to other forms of [C:6:0:1]Fuel[C:7:0:0] later, such as [C:6:0:1]Coal[C:7:0:0], but you will usually need [C:6:0:1]Charcoal[C:7:0:0] from the [C:6:0:0]Wood Furnace[C:7:0:0] to start the process.

title: Traps and levers
document: It is a dangerous world, and if the entrances of your fortress are left open, you can succumb to invasions. [B]The best way to avoid this fate is to build traps and lock the ways into your fortress.  The ways to build traps are as wild as your imagination. Most require [C:6:0:1]Mechanisms[C:7:0:0] made at the [C:6:0:0]Mechanic's Shop[C:7:0:0], using [C:5:0:1]Workshops[C:7:0:0] -> [C:5:0:1]Mechanic[C:7:0:0]. [B]To stop some enemies from entering your fortress use [C:5:0:1]Build[C:7:0:0] -> [C:5:0:1]Machines/fluids[C:7:0:0] -> [C:5:0:1]Lever[C:7:0:0] to build a [C:6:0:0]Lever[C:7:0:0]. Then click on the [C:6:0:0]Lever[C:7:0:0] and choose to link it to a [C:6:0:0]Bridge[C:7:0:0] or [C:6:0:0]Door[C:7:0:0].  This will lock the [C:6:0:0]Door[C:7:0:0] or raise the [C:6:0:0]Bridge[C:7:0:0], locking you inside. [B]There are also predesigned traps, such as [C:6:0:0]Weapon[C:7:0:0], [C:6:0:0]Cage[C:7:0:0], and [C:6:0:0]Stone-Fall Traps[C:7:0:0]. These require a [C:6:0:1]Weapon[C:7:0:0], [C:6:0:1]Cage[C:7:0:0], or [C:6:0:1]Boulder[C:7:0:0] to function.
document_translation: 矮人要塞的世界十分危险，如果你的要塞门户洞开、毫不设防，要塞就会很容易毁于侵略。[B]避免这种悲惨结局的最佳方法是建造陷阱以封锁进入要塞的通道。建造陷阱的方式可尽显汝想象之狂野。大多数陷阱需要在[C:6:0:1]机械工坊[C:7:0:0]制作的[C:6:0:1]机件[C:7:0:0]，使用[C:5:0:1]工坊[C:7:0:0] -> [C:5:0:1]机械师[C:7:0:0]即可下发订单。 [B]如果要阻止一部分敌人进入你的要塞，使用[C:5:0:1]建造[C:7:0:0] -> [C:5:0:1]机器/液体[C:7:0:0] -> [C:5:0:1]拉杆[C:7:0:0]来制作一个[C:6:0:0]拉杆[C:7:0:0]。然后点击[C:6:0:0]拉杆[C:7:0:0]，选择将其链接到[C:6:0:0]桥[C:7:0:0]或[C:6:0:0]门[C:7:0:0]。拉杆将能锁住[C:6:0:0]门[C:7:0:0]或拉起[C:6:0:0]吊桥[C:7:0:0]，将要塞封锁以隔绝外部。[B]还有一些可直接拿来用的陷阱，例如[C:6:0:0]武器陷阱[C:7:0:0]、[C:6:0:0]笼子陷阱[C:7:0:0]和[C:6:0:0]落石陷阱[C:7:0:0]。这些陷阱各需要一个制作好的[C:6:0:1]武器[C:7:0:0]、[C:6:0:1]笼子[C:7:0:0]或[C:6:0:1]开采下来的巨石[C:7:0:0]才能发挥作用。

title: Wells
document: Non-alcoholic water is essential to a functioning fortress.  The most favored place to get it is from a [C:6:0:0]Well[C:7:0:0]. [B][C:6:0:0]Wells[C:7:0:0] require a [C:6:0:1]Bucket[C:7:0:0], [C:6:0:1]Blocks[C:7:0:0], a [C:6:0:1]Rope[C:7:0:0] or [C:6:0:1]Chain[C:7:0:0], and [C:6:0:1]Mechanisms[C:7:0:0].  They can be built over any body of water.  It is possible to find water underground, or divert it from the surface.
document_translation: 非酒精的饮用水对一个正常运作的要塞至关重要。获取水源的最常见方式是通过[C:6:0:0]水井[C:7:0:0]。[B][C:6:0:0]水井[C:7:0:0]需要一个[C:6:0:1]提桶[C:7:0:0]、[C:6:0:1]砖块[C:7:0:0]、一根[C:6:0:1]绳子[C:7:0:0]或[C:6:0:1]链子[C:7:0:0]，以及[C:6:0:1]机件[C:7:0:0]。水井可以建造在任何水体上方。你可以在地下找到水源，或者将水从地表引流过来。

title: Handling light aquifers
document: Aquifers can block the downward progress of your fortress, but it is possible to bypass them. [B]One way is to simply re-designate the damp stone for mining in order to build a 3x3 room around the stairs. You can then build [C:6:0:0]Walls[C:7:0:0] around the stairs until the leaking water is blocked off. [B]Repeat this pattern until you get below the aquifer.
document_translation: 含水层可能会阻碍你要塞的向下扩展，但你可以绕过它们。[B]一种方法是重新指定潮湿的石头进行开采，以在楼梯周围建造一个 3x3 的房间。然后，你可以在楼梯周围建造[C:6:0:0]墙[C:7:0:0]，阻挡周围的水渗入。[B]重复这个过程，直到你穿越含水层。

title: Clothing
document: Eventually the [C:6:0:1]Clothing[C:7:0:0] that your residents start with will rot away. While it is possible to trade for [C:6:0:1]Clothing[C:7:0:0], [C:6:0:1]Cloth[C:7:0:0], or [C:6:0:1]Leather[C:7:0:0], you can also farm [C:6:0:1]Pigtails[C:7:0:0], gather [C:6:0:1]Silk[C:7:0:0], or tan [C:6:0:1]Skins[C:7:0:0] for [C:6:0:1]Leather[C:7:0:0]. [B]After harvesting plants like the [C:6:0:1]Pigtail[C:7:0:0], first process them at the [C:6:0:0]Farmer's Workshop[C:7:0:0], then weave [C:6:0:1]Cloth[C:7:0:0] at the [C:6:0:0]Loom[C:7:0:0], then make [C:6:0:1]Clothing[C:7:0:0] at the [C:6:0:0]Clothier[C:7:0:0]. Gathered [C:6:0:1]Silk[C:7:0:0] can go directly to the [C:6:0:0]Loom[C:7:0:0].[B][C:6:0:1]Skins[C:7:0:0] can be obtained by butchering [C:2:0:0]Livestock[C:7:0:0] at the [C:6:0:0]Butcher's Shop[C:7:0:0]. [C:6:0:1]Skins[C:7:0:0] are tanned at the [C:6:0:0]Tanner's Shop[C:7:0:0], and made into [C:6:0:1]Clothing[C:7:0:0] at the [C:6:0:0]Leather Works[C:7:0:0].

title: Meeting areas and locations
document: [C:3:0:0]Meeting Areas[C:7:0:0] are [C:3:0:0]Zones[C:7:0:0] where your citizens gather when not working or taking care of their needs. [C:3:0:0]Zones[C:7:0:0] can be assigned to special [C:1:0:1]Locations[C:7:0:0]. Usually one [C:3:0:0]Meeting Area[C:7:0:0] is sufficient, but [C:1:0:1]Locations[C:7:0:0] can span several [C:3:0:0]Zones[C:7:0:0]. There are five types of [C:1:0:1]Locations[C:7:0:0], which we'll go over in turn.
document_translation: [C:3:0:0]集会区域[C:7:0:0]是[C:3:0:0]矮人们空闲和解决自身需求时聚集的地方[C:7:0:0]。[C:3:0:0]区域[C:7:0:0]可以分配给特殊的[C:1:0:1]地点[C:7:0:0]。通常，一个[C:3:0:0]会议区域[C:7:0:0]就足够了，但[C:1:0:1]地点[C:7:0:0]可以跨越多个[C:3:0:0]区域[C:7:0:0]。共有五种类型的[C:1:0:1]地点[C:7:0:0]，我们将逐一介绍。

document: [C:7:0:1]Taverns[C:7:0:0][B][C:1:0:1]Taverns[C:7:0:0] are where your residents gather to drink, socialize, tell stories, and dance. [B]To have a fully functioning [C:1:0:1]Tavern[C:7:0:0] you must have a [C:6:0:0]Stockpile[C:7:0:0] with [C:6:0:1]Booze[C:7:0:0] in it, preferably close by. The inhabitants also like to drink from [C:6:0:1]Goblets[C:7:0:0], [C:6:0:1]Cups[C:7:0:0], or [C:6:0:1]Mugs[C:7:0:0].  These must be stored in [C:6:0:0]Chests[C:7:0:0] or [C:6:0:0]Coffers[C:7:0:0] inside the [C:1:0:1]Tavern[C:7:0:0].  Optionally you can place [C:6:0:0]Tables[C:7:0:0] and [C:6:0:0]Chairs[C:7:0:0] where your residents can eat. [B]You may also leave a cleared space your tavern-goers will use as a dance floor.  If you have any [C:6:0:1]Musical Instruments[C:7:0:0] these can also be used by the [C:1:0:1]Tavern[C:7:0:0]. [B]From the [C:5:0:1]Tavern Info Menu[C:7:0:0] you can choose to assign [C:5:0:0]Performers[C:7:0:0] or a [C:5:0:0]Tavern Keeper[C:7:0:0] who will serve the visitors drinks. There is also an option to allow outsiders to come to your [C:1:0:1]Tavern[C:7:0:0].
document_translation: [C:7:0:1]酒馆[C:7:0:0][B][C:1:0:1]酒馆[C:7:0:0]是居民聚会喝酒、社交、讲故事和跳舞的地方。[B]要想有一个功能齐全的[C:1:0:1]酒馆[C:7:0:0]，你必须有一个[C:6:0:0]的仓库[C:7:0:0]，里面有[C:6:0:1]酒[C:7:0:0]，最好在附近。居民们也喜欢用[C:6:0:1]高脚杯[C:7:0:0]、[C:6:0:1]茶杯[C:7:0:0]或[C:6:0:1]柄杯[C:7:0:0]喝酒。这些必须存放在[C:1:0:1]酒馆[C:7:0:0]内的[C:6:0:0]箱子[C:7:0:0]或[C:6:0:0]保险箱[C:7:0:0]中。您可以选择将[C:6:0:0]桌子[C:7:0:0]和[C:6:0:0]椅子[C:7:0:0]放在居民可以吃饭的地方。[B]你也可以留出一片空地，你的酒馆客人会把它当作舞池。如果你有任何[C:6:0:1]乐器[C:7:0:0]，[C:1:0:1]酒馆[C:7:0:0]也可以使用这些乐器。[B]在[C:5:0:1]酒馆信息菜单[C:7:0:0]中，您可以选择指派[C:5:0:0]表演者[C:7:0:0]或[C:5:0:0]酒馆管理员[C:7:0:0]为访客提供饮品。也可以选择允许外人来你的[C:1:0:1]酒馆[C:7:0:0]。

document: [C:7:0:1]Temples[C:7:0:0][B][C:1:0:1]Temples[C:7:0:0] are places for faithful residents to commune with their chosen deity. [B]Upon creation of the [C:1:0:1]Location[C:7:0:0] you must choose which deity to dedicate the [C:1:0:1]Temple[C:7:0:0] to, if any. Sometimes the adherents to a certain religion will demand that you build a [C:1:0:1]Temple[C:7:0:0] to their specific deity. You can see how many worshipers of each deity live in your fortress by scrolling over their names. [B]In the [C:6:0:1]Temple Info Menu[C:7:0:0] you can see the value of the [C:1:0:1]Temple[C:7:0:0].  Sometimes the worshipers will demand that you increase the value of the temple by decorating or adding [C:6:0:0]Furniture[C:7:0:0] like [C:6:0:0]Statues[C:7:0:0]. [B]You can also add [C:6:0:0]Chests[C:7:0:0] or [C:6:0:0]Coffers[C:7:0:0] to hold [C:6:0:1]Musical Instruments[C:7:0:0] that the faithful will use. You can also assign [C:5:0:0]Performers[C:7:0:0] to the [C:1:0:1]Temple[C:7:0:0] and even [C:5:0:0]Priests[C:7:0:0] once the [C:1:0:1]Temple[C:7:0:0] becomes more established.
document_translation: [C:7:0:1]寺庙[C:7:0:0][B][C:1:0:1]寺庙[C:7:0:0]是虔诚居民与他们所选择的神交流的地方。[B]在[C:1:0:1]位置[C:7:0:0]创建后，您必须选择将[C:1:0:1]神庙[C:7:0:0]供奉给哪个神（如果有的话）。有时，某个宗教的信徒会要求你为他们的特定神建造一座[C:1:0:1]神庙[C:7:0:0]。通过滚动每个神的名字，你可以看到你的城堡里有多少祂的信徒。[B]在[C:6:0:1]圣殿信息菜单[C:7:0:0]中，您可以看到[C:1:0:1]神殿[C:7:0:0]的价值。有时信徒会要求你通过装饰或添加[C:6:0:0]家具[C:7:0:0]来增加寺庙的价值，比如[C:6:0:0]雕像[C:7:0:0]。[B]您还可以添加[C:6:0:0]箱子[C:7:0:0]或[C:6:0:0]储物箱[C:7:0:0]来存放信徒将使用的[C:6:0:1]乐器[C:7:0:0]。您还可以将[C:5:0:0]表演者[C:7:0:0]分配给[C:1:0:1]圣殿[C:7:0:0]，甚至在[C:1:0:1]圣殿[C:7:0:0]初具规模后，还可以分配[C:5:0:0]牧师[C:7:0:0]。

document: [C:7:0:1]Hospitals[C:7:0:0][B]Your unfortunate citizens are taken to the [C:1:0:1]Hospital[C:7:0:0] when injured.  There they will rest and given water until they are seen by a [C:5:0:0]Doctor[C:7:0:0]. [B]To fully function your [C:1:0:1]Hospital[C:7:0:0] needs to have [C:6:0:0]Beds[C:7:0:0], [C:6:0:1]Buckets[C:7:0:0] (with a source of water), [C:6:0:1]Thread[C:7:0:0] for sutures, and [C:6:0:1]Cloth[C:7:0:0] for bandages. You must build [C:6:0:0]Chests[C:7:0:0] or [C:6:0:0]Coffers[C:7:0:0] inside the [C:1:0:1]Hospital[C:7:0:0] to store these items. [B]Some injuries require [C:6:0:1]Splints[C:7:0:0], or [C:6:0:1]Gypsum Plaster Powder[C:7:0:0] for [C:6:0:1]Orthopedic Casts[C:7:0:0].  [C:6:0:1]Soap[C:7:0:0] is necessary to prevent infection. Some patients will need [C:6:0:1]Crutches[C:7:0:0] after they are treated. [B]You will need to appoint a [C:5:0:0]Chief Medical Dwarf[C:7:0:0] from the [C:5:0:1]Nobles and administrators[C:7:0:0] menu. You will need to assign a [C:5:0:0]Doctor[C:7:0:0] to the [C:1:0:1]Hospital[C:7:0:0] from the [C:5:0:1]Hospital Info Menu[C:7:0:0]. Later you can assign [C:5:0:0]Doctors[C:7:0:0] to specific roles such as the [C:5:0:0]Diagnostician[C:7:0:0]. [B]The [C:5:0:0]Doctor[C:7:0:0] will need a [C:6:0:0]Table[C:7:0:0] to perform surgeries.  Some injuries will require [C:6:0:0]Traction Benches[C:7:0:0] which can be built at the [C:6:0:0]Mechanic's Shop[C:7:0:0].
document_translation: [C:7:0:1]医院[C:7:0:0][B]公民在不幸受伤后会被送往[C:1:0:1]医院[C:7:0:0]。他们将在那里休息并被喂水，直到[C:5:0:0]医生[C:7:0:0]前来治疗他们。[B]要充分发挥[C:1:0:1]医院[C:7:0:0]的作用，需要[C:6:0:0]床[C:7:0:0]、[C:6:0:1]水桶[C:7:0:0]（且配有水源）、缝合[C:6:0:1]线[C:7:0:0]和作为绷带使用的[C:6:0:1]布匹[C:7:0:0]。您必须在[C:1:0:1]医院[C:7:0:0]内建造[C:6:0:0]箱子[C:7:0:0]或[C:6:0:0]保险箱[C:7:0:0]来存放这些物品。[B]有些损伤需要[C:6:0:1]夹板[C:7:0:0]，或[C:6:0:1]石膏灰泥粉[C:7:0:0]用于施加[C:6:0:1]石膏绷带[C:7:0:0]以治疗骨折。[C:6:0:1]肥皂[C:7:0:0]也是必需的，用于预防感染。一些患者在接受治疗后需要[C:6:0:1]拐杖[C:7:0:0]辅助行走。[B]你需要在[C:5:0:1]贵族和管理员[C:7:0:0]菜单中指定[C:5:0:0]首席矮人医师[C:7:0:0]。你还需要在[C:5:0:1]医院信息菜单[C:7:0:0]中为[C:1:0:1]医院[C:7:0:0]分配[C:5:0:0]医生[C:7:0:0]。稍后，您可以给特定的[C:5:0:0]医生[C:7:0:0]分配特定的职能，如[C:5:0:0]诊断医师[C:7:0:0]等。[B][C:5:0:0]医生[C:7:0:0]需要一张[C:6:0:0]桌子[C:7:0:0]以进行手术。有些损伤需要[C:6:0:0]牵引台[C:7:0:0]进行治疗，它可以在[C:6:0:0]机械工坊[C:7:0:0]被制造。

document: [C:7:0:1]Libraries[C:7:0:0][B]The thirst for knowledge some residents have can be satisfied at the [C:1:0:1]Library[C:7:0:0]. [B]From the [C:5:0:1]Library Info Menu[C:7:0:0] you can assign [C:5:0:0]Scholars[C:7:0:0] who discuss their interests with the inhabitants, and [C:5:0:0]Scribes[C:7:0:0] to record them. Beware!  Some knowledge is dangerous.[B]In order to hold [C:6:0:1]Scrolls[C:7:0:0] and [C:6:0:1]Codices[C:7:0:0] you will need [C:6:0:0]Bookcases[C:7:0:0].  You will also need [C:6:0:0]Tables[C:7:0:0] for your [C:5:0:0]Scribes[C:7:0:0] to work on.  [C:6:0:0]Chests[C:7:0:0] or [C:6:0:0]Coffers[C:7:0:0] are needed to store the [C:6:0:1]Writing Material[C:7:0:0] for the [C:5:0:0]Scribes[C:7:0:0] to write on.
document_translation: [C:7:0:1]图书馆[C:7:0:0][B]一些居民对知识的渴求可以在[C:1:0:1]图书馆[C:7:0:0]中得到满足。[B]从[C:5:0:1]图书馆信息菜单[C:7:0:0]中，你可以指派[C:5:0:0]学者[C:7:0:0]与居民讨论他们的兴趣，并指派[C:5:0:0]抄写员[C:7:0:0]来记录这些信息。不过小心！有些知识是危险的。[B]为了储存[C:6:0:1]卷轴[C:7:0:0]和[C:6:0:1]抄本[C:7:0:0]，你需要[C:6:0:0]书架[C:7:0:0]。你还需要[C:6:0:0]桌子[C:7:0:0]供你的[C:5:0:0]抄写员[C:7:0:0]工作使用。图书馆还需要[C:6:0:0]箱子[C:7:0:0]或[C:6:0:0]保险箱[C:7:0:0]用于存放[C:6:0:1]书写材料[C:7:0:0]，供[C:5:0:0]抄写员[C:7:0:0]书写时使用。

document: [C:7:0:1]Guildhalls[C:7:0:0][B][C:1:0:1]Guildhalls[C:7:0:0] are where the workers of specific professions gather to socialize and share their knowledge. [B]When deciding which guild to dedicate the [C:1:0:1]Guildhall[C:7:0:0] to, you can scroll over the names of the guilds and see how many workers of each profession there are and whether a guild has been established. [B]As the guild grows in power they may demand a [C:1:0:1]Guildhall[C:7:0:0] of greater value.  This can be increased by decorating the hall and building [C:6:0:0]Furniture[C:7:0:0] like [C:6:0:0]Statues[C:7:0:0].
document_translation: [C:7:0:1]行会[C:7:0:0][B][C:1:0:1]行会[C:7:0:0]是特定职业的劳动者聚集在一起社交和分享知识的地方。[B]在决定将[C:1:0:1]行会[C:7:0:0]分配给某个公会时，您可以滚动查看各个公会的名称，看看每个职业有多少劳动者，以及是否已经建立了一个公会。[B]随着公会实力的增长，他们可能会要求一个价值更高的[C:1:0:1]行会[C:7:0:0]。行会价值可以通过装饰大厅和建造[C:6:0:0]家具[C:7:0:0]来增加，比如[C:6:0:0]雕像[C:7:0:0]。

title: Military
document: Before you can create a military, you must appoint a [C:5:0:0]Militia Commander[C:7:0:0] from the [C:5:0:1]Nobles and administrators[C:7:0:0] menu. [B]Then from the [C:5:0:1]Squad[C:7:0:0] menu you can assign your first squad, led by the [C:5:0:0]Commander[C:7:0:0].  First you must assign the uniform.  A new uniform can be assigned later. [B]The squad can be customized and you can select the leader from the buttons at the top of the squad screen.
document_translation: 在创建军队之前，您必须从[C:5:0:1]贵族和管理者[C:7:0:0]菜单中指定[C:5:0:0]民兵指挥官[C:7:0:0]。[B]然后，从[C:5:0:1]小队[C:7:0:0]菜单中，您可以分配由[C:5:0:0]指挥官[C:7:0:0]领导的第一个小队。首先，你必须分配制服。稍后可以分配新制服。[B]小队可以自定义，您可以从小队屏幕顶部的按钮中选择队长。

document: The most important buttons are the checkmark to select the squad to give orders and the [C:5:0:1]Position[C:7:0:0] button to add more soldiers to the squad. You can give individual orders to the soldiers by selecting them with the checkmark from the [C:5:0:1]Position[C:7:0:0] menu or the whole squad from the [C:5:0:1]Squad[C:7:0:0] menu. [B]The orders can be found at the bottom of the [C:5:0:1]Squad[C:7:0:0] menu when somebody is selected.  You can make a [C:3:0:1]Kill[C:7:0:0] order and confirm it. You can make a [C:3:0:1]Station[C:7:0:0] order to have your squad stand in that position.  You can create a [C:3:0:1]Patrol Route[C:7:0:0] and assign your squads to it.  The [C:3:0:1]Defend Burrow[C:7:0:0] order gives you a list of [C:1:0:0]Burrows[C:7:0:0] (created by pressing the [C:5:0:1]Burrow[C:7:0:0] menu) for your squad to defend.  The [C:3:0:1]Training[C:7:0:0] order allows your soldiers to train, but you must first assign a [C:3:0:0]Barracks[C:7:0:0] created from the [C:5:0:1]Zones[C:7:0:0] menu.
document_translation: 最重要的按钮是选中标记，用于选择要下达命令的小队，以及[C:5:0:1]职位[C:7:0:0]按钮，用于向小队添加更多士兵。您可以通过从[C:5:0:1]位置[C:7:0:0]菜单中选择带有复选标记的士兵，或从[C:5:0:1]小队[C:7:0:0]菜单选择整个小队，向士兵下达个人命令。[B]当有人被选中时，可以在[C:5:0:1]小队[C:7:0:0]菜单的底部找到命令。你可以发出[C:3:0:1]击杀[C:7:0:0]的命令并确认。你可以发出[C:3:0:1]站岗[C:7:0:0]命令，让你的小队呆在那个位置。您可以创建[C:3:0:1]巡逻路线[C:7:0:0]并将您的小队分配给它。[C:3:0:1]保卫活动区[C:7:0:0]命令会为您的小队提供一个[C:1:0:0]活动区[C:7:0:0]列表（通过按[C:5:0:1]活动区[C:7:0:0]菜单创建）以进行防御。[C:3:0:1]训练[C:7:0:0]命令允许您的士兵进行训练，但您必须首先分配从[C:5:0:1]区域[C:7:0:0]菜单创建的[C:3:0:0]兵营[C:7:0:0]。

document: The [C:5:0:1]Equipment[C:7:0:0] menu allows you to customize the uniforms of the selected squads. You can assign new uniforms to your squads or add a new one to customize it and add it to the uniform list. You can also click on details to customize each individual soldier.
document_translation: [C:5:0:1]装备[C:7:0:0]菜单允许您自定义所选小队的制式装备。您可以为小队分配新制式装备，也可以自定义一套新制式装备并将其添加到制服列表中。您还可以单击详细信息来定制每个士兵的装备。

document: The [C:5:0:1]Schedule menu[C:7:0:0] is a powerful tool to give automatic orders to the selected squad. Routines are individual orders given to a squad or individual members of a squad.  From here you can assign and edit the routines your soldiers will follow. [B]You can also give your squads a monthly schedule.  The routines are aligned along the top of the grid and the months of the year are shown down the left side.  To assign different orders for each month, line up with your chosen routine, go down the column, and press edit on the orders lining up with the month.  You can also copy an order from any cell.  Clicking on the column itself will assign the routine to the selected squad.
document_translation: [C:5:0:1]日程表菜单[C:7:0:0]是一个强大的工具，可以向选定的士兵小队下达自动命令。日程是给士兵小队或小队中某个成员的单独命令，在这个菜单你可以分派和编辑士兵将遵循的日程规划。[B]你也可以给你的小队制定一个月度计划表。这些日程沿着网格的顶部排列，月份显示在左侧。要为每个月分派不同的命令，请先找到想要的日程，然后循着这一列向下，直到与想要应用的月份对齐时按下“编辑”。您还可以从任何单元格中复制命令。点击列本身将把日程分配给所选的士兵小队。

title: Ramps and channels
document: The regular mining command digs a tunnel into the side of a mountain or deep underground. This leaves a "ceiling" above and "floor" below the empty space you have mined. [B]A ramp is a special square that can be traversed to the level above. There must be space above a ramp and an adjacent wall with an open floor above for the ramp to be usable.[B]Digging a ramp into a wall on the same level will create a connection to the higher level and remove the ceiling. Once a ramp is present, you can start using the regular mining command on the higher level.[B]Digging a channel will mine out a floor or wall at the current level and dig out a ramp at the level below.  If there's no solid ground below the square being channeled, channeling will destroy the floor and create a hole instead.[B]To easily see which ramps go up or down, click the [C:5:0:1]Ramp Vision[C:7:0:0] button by the minimap.
document_translation: 常规采矿指令可以在山腰或地下深处挖掘隧道。这会在您开采的空旷区域上方留下“天花板”，下方留下“地板”。[B]斜坡是一种特殊的地形，可以通过它到达上面的楼层。只有在斜坡正上方有空间，并且斜坡相邻的墙壁上方有开放式地板时，斜坡才能使用。[B]在同一楼层的墙上挖一个斜坡，将与更高楼层建立连接，并拆除天花板。一旦出现斜坡，您就可以开始在上一层使用常规挖掘命令。[B]挖掘一条隧道将在当前层挖掘掉地板或墙壁，并在下一层挖掘出斜坡。如果被挖掘的方格下方并不是坚实的地面，隧道则会破坏地板并形成一个洞。[B]要轻松查看哪些坡道向上或向下，可以单击小地图旁边的[C:5:0:1]斜坡视野[C:7:0:0]按钮。

title: Refuse and dumping
document: As your dwarves live and work in your fortress they will generate [C:6:0:1]Refuse[C:7:0:0]. This includes everything from [C:6:0:1]Bones[C:7:0:0] and other [C:6:0:1]Remains[C:7:0:0] to worn-out [C:6:0:1]Clothing[C:7:0:0]. You can gather the [C:6:0:1]Refuse[C:7:0:0] in a [C:6:0:0]Refuse Stockpile[C:7:0:0]. Some [C:6:0:1]Refuse[C:7:0:0] can be put to use, for instance [C:6:0:1]Shells[C:7:0:0] can be turned into [C:6:0:1]Crafts[C:7:0:0]. Most of it will just generate foul smelling [C:0:0:1]Miasma[C:7:0:0].[B]If your [C:6:0:0]Refuse Stockpile[C:7:0:0] starts to fill up you can create a [C:3:0:0]Dump Zone[C:7:0:0]. Use the [C:5:0:1]Zones[C:7:0:0] menu to select [C:3:0:0]Garbage Dump[C:7:0:0] and draw a rectangle over a cliff or hole and then designate [C:6:0:1]Items[C:7:0:0] for [C:3:0:1]Dumping[C:7:0:0]. This can be done either from the [C:5:0:1]Item's Info Sheet[C:7:0:0] or by dragging a rectangle over everything you want to dump using the [C:5:0:1]Dump Designation[C:7:0:0] tool.
document_translation: 当你的矮人在你的城堡里生活和工作时，他们会产生[C:6:0:1]垃圾[C:7:0:0]。这包括从[C:6:0:1]骨头[C:7:0:0]、其他[C:6:0:1]残骸[C:7:0:0]到破旧[C:6:0:1]衣服[C:7:0:0]的所有东西。你可以将[C:6:0:1]垃圾[C:7:0:0]收集到[C:6:0:0]垃圾储存区[C:7:0:0]中。一些[C:6:0:1]垃圾[C:7:0:0]可以被使用，例如[C:6:0:1]贝壳[C:7:0:0]可以制成[C:6:0:1]工艺品[C:7:0:0]。大部分只会产生恶臭[C:0:0:1]瘴气[C:7:0:0]。[B]如果你的[C:6:0:0]垃圾储存区[C:7:0:0]快满了，你可以创建一个[C:3:0:0]倾倒区[C:7:0:0]。使用[C:5:0:1]区域[C:7:0:0]菜单选择[C:3:0:0]垃圾倾倒区[C:7:0:0]，并在悬崖或洞穴上绘制一个矩形，然后将[C:6:0:1]物品[C:7:0:0]指定为[C:3:0:1]倾倒[C:7:0:0]。这可以从[C:5:0:1]项目信息表[C:7:0:0]中完成，也可以使用[C:5:0:1]转储指定[C:7:0:0]工具在要转储的所有内容上拖动来完成。

title: Dig deeper
document: There are many treasures and perils deep underground. In order to pursue the wealth of the earth, you must dig deeper! Valuable gems and precious metals can be found, along with richer soil, desperately needed water, fungal lumber, and other tantalizing mysteries.
document_translation: 地下深处有许多宝藏，同时也很危险。为了追求地下的财富，你必须挖得更深！在地下，你有可能找到有价值的宝石和贵金属，以及更肥沃的土壤、急需的水、真菌木材和其他诱人的事物。

title: Happiness and stress
document: To attract migrants and build a successful settlement, you will need to keep your citizens happy.[B]There are many ways to maintain your citizens. Alcohol, good food, and personal rooms go a long way. Meet their needs by providing [C:3:0:0]Meeting Areas[C:7:0:0] and [C:1:0:1]Locations[C:7:0:0] for socializing, worship, and study. Monitor their thoughts to identify problems that you can solve.[B]Unhappy citizens can act out and cause trouble, and fewer people will risk travel to a miserable fortress.
document_translation: 为了吸引移民并建立一个成功的定居点，你需要让你的居民满意。[B]有很多方法可以满足你的公民。酒精、美食和私人房间大有裨益。通过提供[C:3:0:0]会议区[C:7:0:0]和[C:1:0:1]地点[C:7:0:0]进行社交、礼拜和学习来满足他们的需求。监控他们的想法，找出你可以解决的问题。[B]不快乐的公民可能会制造麻烦，很少有人会冒险前往一个悲惨的要塞。

title: Goals
document: The current and optional path to victory is to have your fortress elevated to a barony. From there, you can build your wealth, export goods, and attract more migrants until you become a county then a duchy.  A happy fortress with many exports and massive wealth can attract the existing monarch of the civilization.[B]This is the first step to completing the game.  Next, you'll need to satisfy your ruler's needs, and finally become a Mountainhome by seating them on a legendary throne with seven mythical symbols of office. You'll be an accomplished player at this point.[B]But this is only the beginning.  Ultimately, your true goals are up to your imagination. Call visitors from all over the world with the greatest tavern, library, or temple the world has ever known. Build an elaborate water-powered contraption or domesticate previously untameable wild beasts. Settle in unliveable regions tormented by ancient evils and defend your fortress from zombies with your own army of vampires. Your exploits will be recorded for Legends mode and by the master engravers in subsequent fortresses in your world.
document_translation: 一条通往胜利的可选途径是将你的要塞提升为男爵领地。你可以通过积累财富、出口商品、吸引更多的移民来完成，直到你的领地成为一个封郡，甚至成为一个公国。一个拥有众多出口和巨额财富的幸福堡垒可以吸引所处文明的君主。[B]这是完成游戏的第一步。接下来，你需要满足统治者的需求，将他们安置在一个有七个神秘象征以及传奇宝座的办公厅中，你的要塞便能最终成为山地之家。完成这个，你就成为了一名水平高超的玩家。[B]但这仅仅是个开始。最终，你的真正目标取决于你的想象力。吸引来自世界各地的游客，向他们展示世界上有史以来最伟大的酒馆、图书馆或寺庙。建造一个精致的水力装置，或驯养以前无法驯服的野兽。在被古老邪恶折磨的无法居住的地区定居，用自己的吸血鬼军队保卫你的堡垒免受僵尸的攻击。您的功绩将被记录在传奇模式中，并由您世界中后续城堡的雕刻大师记录。
